title: Signed evaluation degree interfaces
statement: For cochain complexes P,Q of A-modules on the one-object bottom-topology site [def-pc-perfect-rhom-base-change-map], define the evaluation of the degree-r dual [lem-pc-perfect-ring-dual-term-flat] by the actual Hom projection at -r followed by the identification A[0]^0=A. Define the sectionwise tensor comparison using the sheafification adjunction unit followed by its tensor comparison. The predicate PerfectRingHomTensorDegreeCondition on a degree-n morphism from the total tensor of the dual of P with Q to Hom(P,Q) requires vanishing on every off-diagonal product coordinate and the pure-tensor formula x maps to (-1)^(r*s) lambda(x)y on coordinate -r, for each r+s=n, with the degree equality transport on Q. These are the original degreewise comparison interfaces.

source.place: Tag 0A6A, lemma-base-change-RHom, clause (1), expanded chain-level evaluation; Tag 0ATK, lemma-base-change-evaluation-map, clause (1)

proof.text: Keep the sectionwise tensor map and normalization predicate unchanged. Evaluate the dual using ringHomComplexProjection at p=-r, then singleObjXIsoOfEq transports A[0]^(-r+r) to A[0]^0=A. The proved private single_projection_evaluation identifies this evaluation with the original projection directly to degree zero: substitute the degree equality and both expressions reduce to the same map. Only the syntax of the projection is changed; the selected dual object, projection family and canonical evaluation are retained.
